title: Liria - Free Speech
tagline: A privacy preserving community driven publication platform to empower authors/whistle-blowers and readers.
description:
- Liria paves a way for journalists across the world to express their views without the risk of getting exposed!
- The creators earn through Native Liria tokens(LRA) for the approvals their articles get and anonymous donations via zkBob.
- Each reader or content creators are uniquely identified(but anonymous) with the help of Worldcoin to avoid sybil attack.
- Liria acts a platform for readers to directly chat with the journalists and express their opinion.
how_its_made:
- Ability to preserve privacy yet maintain reliability by the Journalists.
- Making donations and tokens available to the journalists in a privacy preserving way.
- Various tech issues relating the stack we are using - zkBob api key, Worldcoin verification etc.
